neighbours.label: someone or something free of worry or consequence (unperturbed, "as calmly as if nothing had happened", "nothing to lose", German 'unbesorgt')
fire: The cat walked across the table, unbothered, as if the guests were not there.
She went on reading as calmly as if the alarm had never rung.
You can try the course for a month with nothing to lose.
"Very well," replied the old man, unruffled, "we shall wait."
He strolled past the guards as casually as if he owned the place.
Buchen Sie unbesorgt, denn die Stornierung ist kostenlos.
The pilot, unfazed, carried on with the landing checklist.
They chatted on as though nothing had happened the night before.
quiet: The cat ran across the table, terrified, when the guests arrived.
She stopped reading and jumped up when the alarm rang.
You must pay for the whole course a month in advance.
"Very well," replied the old man, trembling, "we shall leave."
He hurried past the guards, afraid that they would stop him.
Buchen Sie frühzeitig, denn die Zimmer sind schnell ausgebucht.
The pilot, alarmed, abandoned the landing and climbed away.
They argued bitterly about what had happened the night before.

notes: Weak pole (max 10.4). Probes: unperturbed 0.45, as calmly as if 0.80, nothing to lose 0.68, unbesorgt 0.51; 'furious' 0.03, 'shaking as the storm' 0.02.
